target_unit: one unique observed AGRI nominal target timestamp per station; no overlapping init windows multiply samples
target_time: AGRI nominal UTC filename; BJT=UTC+08:00; contemporaneous target with init_time=null; no test payload or targets emitted

model_geometry_inputs.spatial_alignment: per-pixel target-time geometry, cropped on the same 3x3 grid as AGRI/COT
model_geometry_inputs.day_mask: eligibility only; not an input plane; station target is eligible when solar zenith <90deg
model_geometry_inputs.scaling: retain bounded cosine values; do not fit per-window or per-image normalization
model_geometry_inputs.status: candidate aligned with window2 prototype; archived validation formula/crop witness passes; current monthly AGRI/COT per-pixel geometry witness remains pending

ghi_label.observed_ghi: arithmetic mean of the three interval-ending 5-minute measurements; require all three present, finite, nonnegative
ghi_label.clear_sky: Ineichen evaluated at the three 5-minute interval midpoints target-12.5/-7.5/-2.5min; use their mean
ghi_label.kt: mean(GHI)/mean(clear_sky_GHI), unclipped; GHI is label/evaluation only
ghi_label.main_mask: complete valid GHI and clear-sky interval labels AND deterministic target station day flag (SZA<90deg) AND interval mean clear-sky GHI>0
ghi_label.observed_train_val_labels: produced from the same authoritative Sili/Zhujia workbooks used by Hunan M0, selected by this manifest's train/val keys
ghi_label.clear_sky_sampling_audit: Ineichen mean at interval midpoints target-12.5/-7.5/-2.5min; pvlib 0.9.1
ghi_label.sensitivity_mask: same records, day flag, and interval mean clear-sky GHI>=100 W m-2

cot.source: frozen R applied to the complete native AGRI input view at the same target time, then crop station-centered 3x3; no R input-view change
cot.transform: log1p once; one normalization fit on train-only values; no per-image centering
cot.cpp_reference_mask: finite COT in [0,100] AND CLP in {0,1,2} AND all 13 AGRI channels valid AND day_mask>0.5 AND cosSOZ>cos(80deg); zero COT retained if reference-valid

limitations: A subset of candidate daylight labels has genuinely incomplete raw five-minute observations; rows remain masked rather than interpolated. This rate is consistent with the pre-existing M0 workbook audit.

The selected clear-sky midpoint values correspond to the centers of the canonical target-10/-5/0 five-minute measurement intervals; W0 static code audit confirms this time alignment. No endpoint-sampling comparison is required to freeze the contract.
The old saved GHI cohort remains an independent overlap check only; the final monthly-contract label table is rebuilt from its authoritative raw workbook by the new candidate keys.
Station coordinates are the authoritative project schema; the grid receipt does not independently survey station geolocation.
